G3157.def:
**Μαθθάν** (Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ indecl. (Heb. מַתָּן),
**Matthan**: [[Mat.1.15|Mat.1:15]]†
(AS)

G3137.def:
**Μαρία**, -ας (Hellenized form), and Μαριάμ, indecl., ἡ (Aram. מַרְיָם; _Heb._ מִרְיָם)
Mary. In NT;
1. **the mother of Jesus**: [[Mat.1.16|Mat.1:16]] ff. [[Mat.2.11; 13.55|Mat.2:11 13:55]], [[Mrk.6.3|Mrk.6:3]], [[Luk.1.27|Luk.1:27]] ff. [[Luk.2.5, 16; 2.19, 34|Luk.2:5, 16 2:19, 34]], [[Act.1.14|Act.1:14]]
2. M. Magdalene (which see).
3. The wife of Clopas ([[Jhn.19.25|Jhn.19:25]]) and mother of James the little, **and Joses**: [[Mat.27.56, 61; 28.1|Mat.27:56, 61 28:1]], [[Mrk.15.40, 47; 16.1|Mrk.15:40, 47 16:1]], [[Luk.24.10|Luk.24:10]].
4. **The sister of Martha and Lazarus**: [[Luk.10.39, 42|Luk.10:39, 42]] [[Jhn.11.1-2, 19|Jhn.11:1-2, 19]] ff. [[Jhn.12.3|Jhn.12:3]].
5. **The mother of John Mark**: [[Act.12.12|Act.12:12]]
6. A Christian greeted by St. Paul: [[Rom.16.6|Rom.16:6]] (on the signification of the name, see Zorell, see word; on the use of the alternative forms in NT, _DB_, iii, 278 bn).†
(AS)

G3177.def:
**μεθερμηνεύω **
[in LXX: Sirach prologue 23 * ;]
**to translate, interpret**: [[Mat.1.23|Mat.1:23]], [[Mrk.5.41; 15.22, 34|Mrk.5:41 15:22, 34]], [[Jhn.1.38, 42|Jhn.1:38, 42]], [[Act.4.36; 13.8|Act.4:36 13:8]] (cf. ἑρμηνεύω).†
(AS)

G3165.def:
1. apostrophe for με.
2. rarely for μοι, (Homer) (ML)

G3173.def:
**μέγας**, μεγάλη, μέγα,
[in LXX chiefly for גָּדוֹל, also for מַרְבֶּה ,רַב (incl. μείζων), רֹב (μέγιστος) ;]
**great**;
1. **of external form, bodily size, measure, extent**: λίθος, [[Mat.2.60|Mat.2:60]] δράκων, [[Rev.12.3|Rev.12:3]] ἰχθῦς, [[Jhn.21.11|Jhn.21:11]] πόλις, [[Rev.11.8|Rev.11:8]] μάχαιρα, [[Rev.6.4|Rev.6:4]], al.
2. **Of intensity and degree**: δύναμις, [[Act.4.33|Act.4:33]] φόβος, [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]] ἀγάπη, [[Jhn.15.13|Jhn.15:13]] ἄνεμος, [[Jhn.6.18|'ib. 6:18]]; κραυγή, [[Act.23.9|Act.23:9]] φῶς, [[Mat.4.16|Mat.4:16]] πυρετός, [[Luk.4.38|Luk.4:38]] θλίψις, [[Mat.24.21|Mat.24:21]]
3. **Of rank**;
(a) **of persons**: θεός (MM, xvi), [[Tit.2.13|Tit.2:13]] Ἄρτεμις, [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]] compar. (see infr.), [[Mat.18.1|Mat.18:1]] (cf. Dalman, _Words_, 113f.); neut. for masc. (Bl., §32, 1), [[Mat.12.6|Mat.12:6]]
(b) **of things**: ἁμαρτία, [[Jhn.19.11|Jhn.19:11]] μυστήριον, [[Eph.5.32|Eph.5:32]] = μεγίστη (see infr., and cf. Field, _Notes_, 16f.), [[Mat.22.36|Mat.22:36]] compar. for superl. (M, _Pr._, 78), [[1Co.13.13|1Co.13:13]]
4.
(a) Compar., μείζων: [[Mat.11.11; 23.17|Mat.11:11 23:17]], al.; neut. pl., μείζονα, contr. μείζω, [[Jhn.1.51|Jhn.1:51]] double compar., μειζότερος (M, _Pr._, 236; Bl., §11, 4), [[3Jn.4|III Jo 4]];
(b) superl, μέγιστος (Deiss., _BS_, 365), [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]]
(AS)

G3192.def:
**μέλι**, -τος, τό
[in LXX frequently ([[Gen.43.11|Gen.43:11]], al.) for דְּבַשׁ; for נֹפֶת, [[Pro.5.3|Pro.5:3]] ;]
**honey**: [[Rev.10.9-10;|Rev.10:9-10]] ἄγριον (which see), [[Mat.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[Mrk.1.9|Mrk.1:9]].†
(AS)

G3119.def:
**μαλακία -ας**, ἡ
(μαλακός), [in LXX chiefly for חֳלִי [[Deu.7.15; 28.61|Deu.7:15 28:61]], [[Isa.38.9; 53.3|Isa.38:9 53:3]], al. ;]
1. prop., softness, effeminacy (Hdt., Thuc., al).
2. **In NT, as in LXX, = ἀσθένεια, weakness, sickness**: νόσος καὶ μ., [[Mat.4.23; 9.35; 10.1|Mat.4:23 9:35 10:1]].†
_SYN._: see: ἀσθένεια (AS)

G3107.def:
**μακάριος**, -α, -ον
(collat. form of poët. μάκαρ, in Hom., Hes., chiefly of the gods and the departed), [in LXX for אֹשֶׁר ;]
**blessed, happy **(_DCG_, i, 177, 213): θεός (δυνάστης), [[1Ti.1.11; 6.15|1Ti.1:11 6:15]]; ἐλπίς, [[Tit.2.13|Tit.2:13]] esp. in congratulations, usually with the omission of the copula (M, _Pr._, 180; B1., § 30, 3), μ. ὁ, [[Mat.5.3|Mat.5:3]] ff., [[Luk.6.20|Luk.6:20]] ff. [[Jhn.20.29|Jhn.20:29]], [[Rev.1.3|Rev.1:3]], al.; before ptcp., [[Luk.1.45|Luk.1:45]], al.; ὅς, [[Mat.11.6|Mat.11:6]], [[Luk.7.23|Luk.7:23]], [[Rom.4.7-8|Rom.4:7-8]]; ὅτι, [[Mat.13.16|Mat.13:16]], al.; ἐάν, [[Jhn.13.17|Jhn.13:17]], [[1Co.7.40|1Co.7:40]]; compar., μ. . . . μᾶλλον, [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]] -ώτερος, [[1Co.7.40|1Co.7:40]]
_SYN._: εὐλογητός, q.v (AS)

G3189.def:
**μέλας**, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος,
[in LXX: [[Sng.1.5|Sng.1:5]], [[Zec.6.2|Zec.6:2]] (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;]
**black**: [[Rev.6.5, 12|Rev.6:5, 12]]; opposite to λευκός, [[Mat.5.36|Mat.5:36]] neut., τὸ μ., **ink **: [[2Co.3.3|2Co.3:3]], [[2Jn.12|II Jn 12]], [[3Jn.13|3Jn.13]].†
(AS)

G3123.def:
**μάλα **
_adv._, [in LXX for אֲבָל, [[3Ki.1.43|3Ki.1:43]], Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, [[Num.13.32|Num.13:32]] (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), [[Gen.19.9|Gen.19:9]], al.; superlat., [[2Ma.8.7|2Ma.8:7]], [[4Ma.4.22; 12.9; 15.4|4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4]] ;]
I. Pos., **very, very much, exceedingly** (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.).
II. Compar., μᾶλλον.
1. Of increase, **more**; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, [[Mrk.10.48|Mrk.10:48]], [[Luk.18.39|Luk.18:39]], [[Rom.5.15, 17|Rom.5:15, 17]], [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]], al.; πόσῳ, [[Luk.12.24|Luk.12:24]], [[Rom.11.12|Rom.11:12]], al.; τοσούτῳ . . . ὅσῳ, [[Heb.10.25|Heb.10:25]]
2. Of comparison, **the more**: [[Luk.5.15|Luk.5:15]], [[Jhn.5.18|Jhn.5:18]], [[Act.5.14|Act.5:14]], [[1Th.4.1, 10|1Th.4:1, 10]], [[2Pe.1.10|2Pe.1:10]]; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., [[Php.1.9|Php.1:9]] with compar., [[Mrk.7.36|Mrk.7:36]], [[2Co.7.13|2Co.7:13]]; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, [[Php.1.23|Php.1:23]] μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, [[Mat.6.26|Mat.6:26]] μ. ἤ, [[Mat.18.13|Mat.18:13]] with genitive, [[1Co.14.18|1Co.14:18]] as periphr. for compar., [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]], [[1Co.9.15|1Co.9:15]], [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]]; μ. δέ (EV, **yea rather**), [[Rom.8.34|Rom.8:34]]
3. Of preference, **rather, the rather, sooner**: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, [[Mat.6.30|Mat.6:30]], al.; πολύ, [[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]] πόσῳ, [[Mat.7.11|Mat.7:11]], al.; in a question, οὐ μ., [[1Co.9.12|1Co.9:12]] after a neg., [[Mat.10.6|Mat.10:6]], al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., [[1Co.14.5|1Co.14:5]], [[2Co.5.8|2Co.5:8]]; ζηλῶ, [[1Co.14.1|1Co.14:1]] with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, [[Jhn.3.19|Jhn.3:19]] μ. δέ, [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]]
III. Superl., **μάλιστα**
, **most, most of all, above all**: [[Act.20.38; 25.26|Act.20:38 25:26]], [[Gal.6.10|Gal.6:10]], [[Php.4.22|Php.4:22]], [[1Ti.4.10; 5.8, 17|1Ti.4:10 5:8, 17]], [[2Ti.4.13|2Ti.4:13]], [[Tit.1.10|Tit.1:10]], Phm 16, [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]]; μ. γνώστης, [[Act.26.3|Act.26:3]]
(AS)

G3142.def:
**μαρτύριον**, -ου, τό
(μάρτυρ) [in LXX chiefly for מוֹעֵד, also for עֵדָה, עֵדוּת and cogn. forms ;]
**a testimony, witness, proof **(Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive subj., [[2Co.1.12|2Co.1:12]], [[2Th.1.10|2Th.1:10]]; with genitive obj., [[Act.4.33|Act.4:33]], [[1Co.1.6; 2.1|1Co.1:6 2:1]] (WH, txt., R, txt., μυστήριον; [[2Ti.1.8|2Ti.1:8]] εἰς μ., [[Mat.8.4; 10.18|Mat.8:4 10:18]] [[Mat.24.14|Mat.24:14]], [[Mrk.1.44; 6.11; 13.9|Mrk.1:44 6:11 13:9]], [[Luk.5.14; 9.5; 21.13|Luk.5:14 9:5 21:13]], [[Heb.3.5|Heb.3:5]], [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]]; τὸ μ. καιροῖς ἰδίοις (CGT, in l), [[1Ti.2.6|1Ti.2:6]] ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μ. (LXX for מוֹעֵד אֹהֶל), [[Act.7.44|Act.7:44]], [[Rev.15.5|Rev.15:5]].†
(AS)

G3112.def:
**μακράν (prop. fem. accusative of μακρός**, Sc. ὁδόν), adv. ,
[in LXX for רָחוֹק hi., רָחַק, etc. ;]
**a long way, far**: [[Luk.15.20|Luk.15:20]], [[Act.22.21|Act.22:21]]; before ἀπό, [[Mat.8.30|Mat.8:30]], [[Luk.7.6|Luk.7:6]], [[Jhn.21.8|Jhn.21:8]], [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]]; id. metaphorically, [[Mrk.12.34|Mrk.12:34]] οἱ εἰς μ., [[Act.2.39|Act.2:39]] (cf. [[Isa.2.2|Isa.2:2]]); metaphorically, οἱ ποτὲ ὄντες μ. (opposite to ἐγγύς), [[Eph.2.13|Eph.2:13]] οἱ μ., [[Eph.2.17|Eph.2:17]]†
(AS)

G3156.def:
**Μαθθαῖος** (Rec. Ματθ-, see WH, _App._, 159; Bl., § 3, 11; on the Semitic form, see Dalman, _Words_, 51; _Gr._, 142), -ου, ὁ,
**Matthew**: Mt title., [[Mat.9.9; 10.3|Mat.9:9 10:3]], [[Mrk.3.18|Mrk.3:18]], [[Luk.6.15|Luk.6:15]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]] (cf. Λευεί).†
(AS)

G3129.def:
**μανθάνω **
[in LXX chiefly for לָמַד ;]
1. to learn, esp. by inquiry: absol., [[1Co.14.31|1Co.14:31]], [[1Ti.2.11|1Ti.2:11]], [[2Ti.3.7|2Ti.3:7]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Jhn.7.15|Jhn.7:15]] (sc. αὐτά), [[Rom.16.17|Rom.16:17]], [[1Co.14.35|1Co.14:35]], [[Php.4.9|Php.4:9]], [[2Ti.3.14|2Ti.3:14]], [[Rev.14.3|Rev.14:3]]; before quaes. indir., [[Mat.9.13|Mat.9:13]] Χριστόν, [[Eph.4.20|Eph.4:20]] (_ICC_, in l); before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.24.32|Mat.24:32]], [[Mrk.13.28|Mrk.13:28]]; ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.11.29|Mat.11:29]], [[Col.1.7|Col.1:7]]; παρά, with genitive of person(s), [[2Ti.3.14|2Ti.3:14]] ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[1Co.4.6|1Co.4:6]] "point" aorist (M, _Pr._, 117), to ascertain, before ὅτι, [[Act.23.27|Act.23:27]] with accusative before ἀπό, [[Gal.3.2|Gal.3:2]]
2. **to learn by use and practice, acquire the habit of, be accustomed to**: with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4), [[1Ti.5.4|1Ti.5:4]], [[Tit.3.14|Tit.3:14]]; id. with nom, in pred. (El., § 72, 1), [[Php.4.11|Php.4:11]] with accusative of thing(s) before ἀπό, [[Heb.5.8|Heb.5:8]] ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν (EV, they learn to be idle; Bl., § 73, 5; Field, _Notes_, 210), [[1Ti.5.13|1Ti.5:13]]†
(AS)

G3146.def:
**μαστιγόω**, -ῶ
(μάστιξ) [in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi. ;]
**to scourge**: with accusative, [[Mat.10.17; 20.19; 23.34|Mat.10:17 20:19 23:34]], [[Mrk.10.34|Mrk.10:34]], [[Luk.18.33|Luk.18:33]], [[Jhn.19.1|Jhn.19:1]]; metaphorically, [[Heb.12.6|Heb.12:6]] (cf. [[Pro.3.12|Pro.3:12]], [[Jer.5.3|Jer.5:3]], [[Jdt.8.27|Jdth.8:27]]).†
(AS)

G3162.def:
**μάχαιρα**, -ης
(Att.. -ας; see WH, _App._, 1568; ΒΙ., § 7, 1), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for חֶרֶב; also for מַאֲכֶלֶת, etc. ;]
1. (in Hom., al.) a large knife or dirk, for sacrificial purposes ([[Gen.22.6, 10|Gen.22:6, 10]], [[Jdg.19.20|Jdg.19:20]] A).
2. **a short sword or dagger **(as disting. from ῥομφαία, a large broad sword and ξίφος, a straight sword for thrusting): [[Mat.26.47|Mat.26:47]] ff., [[Mrk.14.43, 47-48|Mrk.14:43, 47-48]], [[Luk.22.36|Luk.22:36]] ff., [[Jhn.18.10-11|Jhn.18:10-11]] [[Act.16.27|Act.16:27]], [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]], [[Rev.6.4; 13.10, 14|Rev.6:4 13:10, 14]]; στόμα μαχαίρης (as in _Heb._ חֶרֶב פֶּה, [[Gen.34.26|Gen.34:26]], al.), the edge of the sword: [[Luk.21.24|Luk.21:24]], [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]]; μ. δίστομος, [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]] ἀναιρεῖν μαχαίρῃ, [[Act.12.2|Act.12:2]] τὴν μ. φορεῖν, [[Rom.13.4|Rom.13:4]] Metaphorical, [[Mat.10.34|Mat.10:34]] (opposite to εἰρήνη), [[Rom.8.35|Rom.8:35]] μ. τοῦ πνεῦματος, [[Eph.6.17|Eph.6:17]]†
(AS)

G3100.def:
**μαθητεύω**
(μαθητής),
1. intrans. (as prop. vb. in -εύω, and so Plut., mor. 837 with and elsew.), **to be a disciple**: with dative, [[Mat.27.57|Mat.27:57]] (Rec., WH, mg.).
2. Trans., **to make a disciple**: with accusative, [[Mat.28.19|Mat.28:19]], [[Act.14.21|Act.14:21]]; pass., before dative, τ. Ἰησοῦ, [[Mat.27.57|Mat.27:57]] (WH, R); τ. βασιλείᾳ, [[Mat.13.52|Mat.13:52]]†
(AS)

G3155.def:
**μάτην**
(prop. accusative of μάτη, a fault, folly), adv., [in LXX for הָבַל, שָׁוְא, etc. ;]
**in vain, to no purpose**: [[Mat.15.9|Mat.15:9]], [[Mrk.7.7|Mrk.7:7]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3114.def:
**μακροθυμέω**, -ῶ
(μακρό-θυμος, long-tempered; see: -ία), [in LXX: [[Ecc.8.12|Ecc.8:12]] א2, [[Pro.19.11|Pro.19:11]] (אָרַךְ, אַף אָרַךְ), [[Job.7.16|Job.7:16]], [[Sir.2.4|Sir.2:4]], al. ;]
1. actively = καρτερέω, to persevere (Plut., 2, 593 F).
2. **Passively, to be patient, long-suffering**: absol., [[1Co.13.4|1Co.13:4]], [[Heb.6.15|Heb.6:15]], [[Jas.5.8|Jas.5:8]]; before ἕως, with genitive, [[Jas.5.7|Jas.5:7]] ἐπί, with dative, ib. ([[Sir.2.4|Sir.2:4]]); πρός, with accusative, [[1Th.5.14|1Th.5:14]] ἐπί, with dative, [[Mat.18.26, 29|Mat.18:26, 29]], [[Luk.18.7|Luk.18:7]]; εἰς, [[2Pe.3.9|2Pe.3:9]]†
_SYN._: ὑπομένω, q.v (AS)

G3199.def:
**μέλω **
[in LXX: [[Job.22.3|Job.22:3]] (חֵפֶץ), [[Tob.10.5|Tob.10:5]], [[Wis.12.13|Wis.12:13]], [[1Ma.14.42-43|1Ma.14:42-43]] * ;]
1. intrans., to be an object of care, be a care; commonly in third of person(s): with dative of person(s), [[Act.18.17|Act.18:17]] very frequently impers., [[1Co.7.21|1Co.7:21]] before ὅτι, [[Mrk.4.38|Mrk.4:38]], [[Luk.10.40|Luk.10:40]]; with genitive of thing(s) (as frequently in Att..), [[1Co.9.9|1Co.9:9]] before περί, [[Mat.22.16|Mat.22:16]], [[Mrk.12.14|Mrk.12:14]], [[Jhn.10.13; 12.6|Jhn.10:13 12:6]], [[1Pe.5.7|1Pe.5:7]].
2. Trans., in act. and mid., to care for (not in LXX or NT).†
(AS)

G3170.def:
**μεγαλύνω**
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גָּדַל pi., hi. ;]
1. **to make great**: [[Mat.23.5|Mat.23:5]], [[Luk.1.58|Luk.1:58]].
2. **to declare great, extol, magnify**: [[Luk.1.46|Luk.1:46]], [[Act.5.13; 10.46; 19.17|Act.5:13 10:46 19:17]], [[2Co.10.15|2Co.10:15]]; pass., before ἐν, [[Php.1.20|Php.1:20]]†
(AS)

G3140.def:
**μαρτυρέω**, -ῶ
(μάρτυς), [in LXX chiefly for עֵד (עֵד ([[Gen.31.47-48|Gen.31:47-48]], al.), also for עוּד hi. ([[Gen.43.3|Gen.43:3]], [[Lam.2.13|La 2:13]]), עָנָה ([[Num.35.30|Num.35:30]]) ;]
(a) prop., **to be a witness, bear witness, testify**: absol. (find., al.), [[Jhn.15.27|Jhn.15:27]], [[Act.26.5|Act.26:5]]; parenthetical (Bl., § 79, 7; MM, xvi), [[2Co.8.3|2Co.8:3]] with dative of person(s) (comm. and incomm.; El., § 37, 2), [[Act.22.5|Act.22:5]], [[Heb.10.15|Heb.10:15]]; id. before ὅτι, [[Mat.23.31|Mat.23:31]], [[Rom.10.2|Rom.10:2]], al.; accusative and inf., [[Act.10.43|Act.10:43]] with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), [[Jhn.3.11|Jhn.3:11]], [[Rev.22.16, 20|Rev.22:16, 20]]; with accusative cogn., before περί, [[Jhn.5.32|Jhn.5:32]], [[1Jn.5.10|1Jn.5:10]]; with dative of thing(s), [[Jhn.5.33|Jhn.5:33]], [[Act.14.3|Act.14:3]], al.; before περί, with genitive (of person(s) and of thing(s)), [[Jhn.1.7-8, 15; 2.25; 18.23; 21.24|Jhn.1:7-8, 15 2:25 18:23 21:24]], al.; id. before ὅτι, [[Jhn.5.36; 7.7|Jhn.5:36 7:7]]; ὅτι, [[Jhn.1.34; 4.44|Jhn.1:34 4:44]] al.; ὅτι recit., [[Jhn.4.39|Jhn.4:39]] κατά before ὅτι, [[1Co.15.15|1Co.15:15]] pass., [[Heb.7.8|Heb.7:8]] ptcp., [[Rom.3.21|Rom.3:21]] impers., [[Heb.7.17|Heb.7:17]]
(b) in late Gk., **to witness favourably, give a good report, approve **(Bl., § 54, 3; MM, xvi; Deiss., BS, 265): with dative of person(s), [[Luk.4.22|Luk.4:22]] before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), [[Heb.11.4|Heb.11:4]] pass., [[Act.6.3|Act.6:3]] before ἐν, [[1Ti.5.10|1Ti.5:10]], [[Heb.11.2|Heb.11:2]]; διά, with genitive of thing(s), [[Heb.11.39|Heb.11:39]] with genitive of person(s), [[Act.10.22|Act.10:22]], al.; impers., [[3Jn.12|III Jn 12]] (cf. ἐπι, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-μαρτυρέω)
(AS)

G3184.def:
**μεθύω**
(μέθυ, wine, cf. μέθη), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַר, רָוָה ;]
**to be drunken**: [[Mat.24.49|Mat.24:49]], [[Jhn.2.10|Jhn.2:10]], [[Act.2.15|Act.2:15]], [[1Co.11.21|1Co.11:21]], [[1Th.5.7|1Th.5:7]]; metaphorically, [[Rev.17.2|Rev.17:2]], 6.†
(AS)

G3148.def:
**μάστιξ**, -ιγος, ἡ
[in LXX for שׁוֹט, etc. ;]
**a whip, scourge**: [[Act.22.24|Act.22:24]], [[Heb.11.36|Heb.11:36]]; metaphorically, of disease or suffering as a divine chastisement (cf. [[Psa.89.33|Psa.89:33]], [[Pro.3.12|Pro.3:12]], [[2Ma.9.11|2Ma.9:11]]), [[Mrk.3.10; 5.29, 34|Mrk.3:10 5:29, 34]], [[Luk.7.21|Luk.7:21]]
(AS)

G3175.def:
**μεγιστάν**, -ᾶνος, ὁ
(μέγιστος) [in LXX chiefly for שַׂר, [[Jer.24.8|Jer.24:8]], al.; רַבְרְבָן, Dan LXX TH [[Dan.5.23|Dan.5:23]], al.; frequently in Sir (sing., [[Sir.4.7|Sir.4:7]]) ;]
usually pl., οἱ μ., **the chief men, nobles **(Manetho, FlJ, al.): [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]], [[Rev.6.15; 18.23|Rev.6:15 18:23]].†
(AS)

G3117.def:
**μακρός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for אָרֹךְ, רָחוֹק and cognate forms, etc. ;]
**of space and time, long**: μακρὰ προσεύχεσθαι, [[Mrk.12.40|Mrk.12:40]], [[Luk.20.47|Luk.20:47]].
**of distance, far, far distant**: χώρα, [[Luk.15.13; 19.12|Luk.15:13 19:12]].†
(AS)

G3106.def:
**μακαρζω**
(μακάριος), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pi., pu. ;]
**to bless, pronounce blessed or happy**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.1.48|Luk.1:48]], [[Jas.5.11|Jas.5:11]].†
(AS)

G3158.def:
**Μαθθάτ** (T, -άθ; Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. מַתָּת),
**Matthat**: [[Luk.3.29|Luk.3:29]] (cf. Ματθάτ).†
**Matthat**: [[Luk.3.24|Luk.3:24]] (T, Μαθθάθ),†
Ματθάτ (see: Μαθθάτ),
(AS)

G3168.def:
**μεγαλειότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(μεγαλεῖος) [in LXX: [[Jer.33.9|Jer.33:9]] (תִּפְאָרָה), Dan LXX 7:27, [[1Es.1.5|1Es.1:5]] [[Est.4.40|Est.4:40]] * ;]
**splendour, magnificence**: [[Luk.9.43|Luk.9:43]], [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]], [[2Pe.1.16|2Pe.1:16]] (frequently in π. as a ceremonial title, MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3149.def:
**μαστός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שַׁד ;]
**the breast**: pl., [[Luk.11.27; 23.29|Luk.11:27 23:29]], [[Rev.1.13|Rev.1:13]] (T, μασθοῖς; WH, _App._, 149; L, μαζοῖς).†
(AS)

G3182.def:
**μεθύσκω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.23.5|Psa.23:5]] (רָוָה), [[Pro.4.17|Pro.4:17]] (שָׁתָה), etc. ;]
causal of μεθύω,
**to make drunk, intoxicate**; pass., **to get drunk**: [[Luk.12.45|Luk.12:45]], [[Eph.5.18|Eph.5:18]], [[1Th.5.7|1Th.5:7]].†
(AS)

G3179.def:
**μεθ-ίστημι** and (late form, [[1Co.13.2|1Co.13:2]]) μεθιστάνω,
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;]
trans. in Pres., impf., fut. and aor. 1,
**to change, remove**: with accusative of thing(s), ὄρη, [[1Co.13.2|1Co.13:2]] (cf. [[Isa.54.10|Isa.54:10]]); with accusative of person(s): before εἰς, [[Col.1.13|Col.1:13]] before ἐκ, pass., [[Luk.16.4|Luk.16:4]] of causing death (cf. similar intrans. sense, Eur., Alc., 21, al.), [[Act.13.22|Act.13:22]] Metaphorical (cf. τ. καρδίαν μ., [[Jos.14.8|Jos.14:8]]), with accusative of person(s), **to pervert**: [[Act.19.26|Act.19:26]]†
(AS)

G3178.def:
**μέθη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַר and cognate forms ;]
**drunkenness**: [[Luk.21.34|Luk.21:34]] pl., [[Rom.13.13|Rom.13:13]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]] †
_SYN._: see: κῶμος (AS)

G3131.def:
**μάννα**, τό ,
(in FlJ, also ἡ),
indecl.
[in LXX: τὸ μάν, [[Exo.16.31|Exo.16:31]] ff., elsewhere τ. μάννα, [[Num.11.6|Num.11:6]] ff., al. (מָן, Aram. מַנָּא) ;]
**manna**: [[Jhn.6.31, 49|Jhn.6:31, 49]], [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]]; symb., [[Rev.2.17|Rev.2:17]]†
(AS)

G3164.def:
**μάχομαι **
[in LXX chiefly for רִיב, also for נָצָה ni., etc. ;]
1. to fight: [[Act.7.26|Act.7:26]]
2. **to quarrel, dispute**: [[2Ti.2.24|2Ti.2:24]], [[Jas.4.2|Jas.4:2]]; πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[Jhn.6.52|Jhn.6:52]] (cf. δια-μάχομαι).†
(AS)

G3167.def:
**μεγαλεῖος**, -εία, -εῖον
(μέγας) [in LXX: [[Psa.71.19|Psa.71:19]] (גָּדוֹל), al., frequently in Sir ;]
magnificent, splendid (Xen., Plut., al.) : [[Act.2.11|Act.2:11]]†
(AS)

G3191.def:
**μελετάω**, -ῶ
(μελέτη, care), [in LXX chiefly for הָגָה m ;]
1. with genitive, to care for (Hes.).
2. C. accusative to attend to, **practise**: [[1Ti.4.15|1Ti.4:15]] (RV, be diligent in; cf. Souter in _Exp._, VIII, vi, 429, but see infr.).
3. **to study, ponder**: [[Act.4.25|Act.4:25]] (LXX) [[1Ti.4.15|1Ti.4:15]] (AV, meditate on; cf. CGT, in l, but see supr.; cf. προ-μελετάω).†
(AS)

G3102.def:
**μαθήτρια**, -ας, ἡ
(= μαθητρίς, fem, of μαθητής, which see)
**a female disciple**: [[Act.9.36|Act.9:36]]†
(AS)

G3152.def:
**μάταιος**, -ον
(as in Att.., but -αία, -αιον, [[1Co.15.17|1Co.15:17]], [[1Pe.1.18|1Pe.1:18]]; μάτην), [in LXX for שָׁוְא, הֶבֶל, כָּזָב, etc. ;]
**vain, useless**: ἀνωφελὴς κ. μ., [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]] πίστις, [[1Co.15.17|1Co.15:17]] θρησκεία, [[Jas.1.26|Jas.1:26]] διαλογισμοί, [[1Co.3.20|1Co.3:20]] (LXX); ἀναστροφή, [[1Pe.1.18|1Pe.1:18]] of idols and heathen gods, τὰ μ. ([[Jer.2.5|Jer.2:5]], [[2Ki.17.15|4Ki.17:15]], al.): [[Act.14.15|Act.14:15]]
_SYN._: κενός, q.v (AS)

G3132.def:
**μαντεύομαι**
(μαντίς, a seer, diviner), [in LXX for קָסַם, [[Deu.18.10|Deu.18:10]], al. ;]
**to divine, practise divination**: [[Act.16.16|Act.16:16]]†
_SYN._: προφητεύω, which see, in distinction from which μ. is used in LXX and NT only of false prophets and those who practise the heathen arts of divination and soothsaying (cf. [[1Sa.28.8|1Ki.28:8]], and see Tr., _Syn._, § vi) (AS)

G3143.def:
**μαρτύρομαι**
(μάρτυρ), [in LXX: [[Jdt.7.28|Jdth.7:28]], [[1Ma.2.56|1Ma.2:56]] א)* ;]
to summon as witness (M, _Th._, 25 f.; Hort., 1Pe., 53 f.; Lft., _Notes_, 29; Ga 203), hence,
(a) **to protest, affirm solemnly**: before ὅτι, [[Act.20.26|Act.20:26]], [[Gal.5.3|Gal.5:3]];
(b) **to adjure, beseech**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.26.22|Act.26:22]] with accusative and inf., [[Eph.4.17|Eph.4:17]] before εἰς, [[1Th.2.12|1Th.2:12]] (cf. δια-, προ-μαρτύρομαι).†
(AS)

G3122.def:
**μάλιστα**, see: μάλα.
**μάλα **
_adv._, [in LXX for אֲבָל, [[3Ki.1.43|3Ki.1:43]], Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, [[Num.13.32|Num.13:32]] (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), [[Gen.19.9|Gen.19:9]], al.; superlat., [[2Ma.8.7|2Ma.8:7]], [[4Ma.4.22; 12.9; 15.4|4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4]] ;]
I. Pos., **very, very much, exceedingly** (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.).
II. Compar., μᾶλλον.
1. Of increase, **more**; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, [[Mrk.10.48|Mrk.10:48]], [[Luk.18.39|Luk.18:39]], [[Rom.5.15, 17|Rom.5:15, 17]], [[Php.2.12|Php.2:12]], al.; πόσῳ, [[Luk.12.24|Luk.12:24]], [[Rom.11.12|Rom.11:12]], al.; τοσούτῳ . . . ὅσῳ, [[Heb.10.25|Heb.10:25]]
2. Of comparison, **the more**: [[Luk.5.15|Luk.5:15]], [[Jhn.5.18|Jhn.5:18]], [[Act.5.14|Act.5:14]], [[1Th.4.1, 10|1Th.4:1, 10]], [[2Pe.1.10|2Pe.1:10]]; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., [[Php.1.9|Php.1:9]] with compar., [[Mrk.7.36|Mrk.7:36]], [[2Co.7.13|2Co.7:13]]; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, [[Php.1.23|Php.1:23]] μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, [[Mat.6.26|Mat.6:26]] μ. ἤ, [[Mat.18.13|Mat.18:13]] with genitive, [[1Co.14.18|1Co.14:18]] as periphr. for compar., [[Act.20.35|Act.20:35]], [[1Co.9.15|1Co.9:15]], [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]]; μ. δέ (EV, **yea rather**), [[Rom.8.34|Rom.8:34]]
3. Of preference, **rather, the rather, sooner**: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, [[Mat.6.30|Mat.6:30]], al.; πολύ, [[Heb.12.25|Heb.12:25]] πόσῳ, [[Mat.7.11|Mat.7:11]], al.; in a question, οὐ μ., [[1Co.9.12|1Co.9:12]] after a neg., [[Mat.10.6|Mat.10:6]], al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., [[1Co.14.5|1Co.14:5]], [[2Co.5.8|2Co.5:8]]; ζηλῶ, [[1Co.14.1|1Co.14:1]] with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, [[Jhn.3.19|Jhn.3:19]] μ. δέ, [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]]
III. Superl., **μάλιστα**
, **most, most of all, above all**: [[Act.20.38; 25.26|Act.20:38 25:26]], [[Gal.6.10|Gal.6:10]], [[Php.4.22|Php.4:22]], [[1Ti.4.10; 5.8, 17|1Ti.4:10 5:8, 17]], [[2Ti.4.13|2Ti.4:13]], [[Tit.1.10|Tit.1:10]], Phm 16, [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]]; μ. γνώστης, [[Act.26.3|Act.26:3]]
(AS)

G3147.def:
**μαστίζω**
(Ep. and late prose = Att.. μαστιγόω) [in LXX: [[Num.22.25|Num.22:25]] (נָכָה hi.), [[Wis.5.11|Wis.5:11]], [[2Ma.2.21|2Ma.2:21]] * ;]
**to whip, scourge**: with accusative, [[Act.22.25|Act.22:25]]†
(AS)

G3194.def:
**Μελίτη ** (Rec., R, txt.), Μελιτήνη (WH, R, mg., see WH, _App._, 160),
Melita, Melitene (mod. Malta) : [[Act.28.1|Act.28:1]]†
(AS)

G3154.def:
**ματαιόω**, -ῶ
(μάταιος), [in LXX: [[4Ki.17.15|4Ki.17:15]], [[Jer.2.5|Jer.2:5]], al. הָבַל, etc. ;]
**to make vain, foolish**: [[Rom.1.21|Rom.1:21]]†
(AS)

G3108.def:
**μακαρισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(μακαρίζω)
**a declaration of blessedness, felicitation**: [[Rom.4.6|Rom.4:6]], 9, [[Gal.4.15|Gal.4:15]] (Plat., Arist.).†
(AS)

G3153.def:
**ματαιότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(μάταιος), [in LXX for הֶבֶל, [[Psa.31.6; 39.5; 62.9|Psa.31:6 39:5 62:9]], al., and nearly 40 times in Ec; for שָׁוְא, [[Psa.25.4|Psa.25:4]], al.; רִיק, etc. ;]
**vanity, emptiness, frailty, folly**: [[Rom.8.20|Rom.8:20]], [[2Pe.2.18|2Pe.2:18]]; τ. νοός, [[Eph.4.17|Eph.4:17]] (elsewhere only in Pollux, 6, 134, and Eccl.).†
(AS)

G3183.def:
**μέθυσος**, -α, -ον
(also -ος, -ον; prop., only of women, but in late writers also = μεθυστικός, of men), [in LXX: [[Pro.23.21|Pro.23:21]] (סָבָא) [[Pro.26.9|Pro.26:9]] (שִׁכּוֹר), [[Sir.19.1; 26.8|Sir.19:1 26:8]], [[4Ma.2.7|4Ma.2:7]] * ;]
**drunken**: [[1Co.5.11; 6.10|1Co.5:11 6:10]].†
(AS)

G3111.def:
**μάκελλον**, -ου, τό (Lat. macellum),
**a meat-market**: [[1Co.10.25|1Co.10:25]] (see Deiss., _LAE_, 274; MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3134.def:
**μαρὰν ἀθά** (Rec. μαραναθά; Aram.: on the original form see Dalman, _Gr._, § 41, 1; 74, 3; _Words_, 328),
Maranatha, i.e. the Lord cometh (but see Dalman, ll. with; Field, _Notes_, 180; _ICC_, in l): [[1Co.16.22|1Co.16:22]]†
(AS)

G3188.def:
**μέλαν**, τό, see: μέλας.
**μέλας**, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος,
[in LXX: [[Sng.1.5|Sng.1:5]], [[Zec.6.2|Zec.6:2]] (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;]
**black**: [[Rev.6.5, 12|Rev.6:5, 12]]; opposite to λευκός, [[Mat.5.36|Mat.5:36]] neut., τὸ μ., **ink **: [[2Co.3.3|2Co.3:3]], [[2Jn.12|II Jn 12]], [[3Jn.13|3Jn.13]].†
(AS)

G3163.def:
**μάχη**, -ης, ἡ
(μάχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
1. a fight.
2. **a strife, contention, quarrel**: [[2Co.7.5|2Co.7:5]], [[2Ti.2.23|2Ti.2:23]], [[Jas.4.1|Jas.4:1]]; pl., [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]]†
(AS)

G3174.def:
**μέγεθος**, -ους, τό
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for קוֹמָה ;]
**greatness**: [[Eph.1.19|Eph.1:19]] (cf. MM, xvi, see word μέγας).†
(AS)

G3180.def:
**μεθ-οδία** (Rec. -εία; cf. 131., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(† μεθοδεύω, 1. to treat by rule. 2. to employ craft: [[2Ki.19.27|4Ki.19:27]] *)
**craft, deceit**: [[Eph.4.14; 6.11|Eph.4:14 6:11]] (not found elsewhere; see AR, in l).†
(AS)

G3118.def:
**μακρο-χρόνιος**, -ον
(μακρός, χρόνος), [in LXX. μ. γίγνεσθαι, εἶναι (יוֹם אָרַךְ), [[Exo.20.12|Exo.20:12]], [[Deu.4.40; 5.16; 17.20|Deu.4:40 5:16 17:20]] * ;]
**of long duration, longlived**: [[Eph.6.3|Eph.6:3]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G3125.def:
**μάμμη**, -ης, ἡ
(onomatop.), [in LXX: [[4Ma.16.9|4Ma.16:9]] * ;]
1. in cl., a child's name for mother.
2. In late Gk. (= cl., τήθη), **a grandmother**: (LXX, l.with), [[2Ti.1.5|2Ti.1:5]]†
(AS)

G3172.def:
**μεγαλωσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גְּדוּלָה and cogn. forms, [[2Ki.7.23|2Ki.7:23]], [[Psa.145.3|Psa.145:3]], al. ;]
**greatness, majesty**: [[Heb.1.3; 8.1|Heb.1:3 8:1]], [[Jude.25|Ju 25]] (elsewhere Eccl. only).†
(AS)

G3133.def:
**μαραίνω **
[in LXX: [[Job.15.30|Job.15:30]] (יָבֵשׁ pi.), [[Job.24.24|Job.24:24]], [[Wis.2.8; 19.21|Wis.2:8 19:21]] * ;]
in cl.,
1. prop., to quench fire; pass., of fire, to die away, go out.
2. In various relations, to quench, waste, wear out (cf. [[Wis.19.21|Wis.19:21]]); pass., to waste away; in later writers (Plut., Luc., al.), of the withering of flowers and herbage (act., [[Job.15.30|Job.15:30]] pass., [[Job.24.24|Job.24:24]], [[Wis.2.8|Wis.2:8]]): [[Jas.1.11|Jas.1:11]] (cf. ἀμάραντον).†
(AS)

G3169.def:
**μεγαλοπρεπής**, ές (= μεγάλῳ πρέπων),
[in LXX: [[Deu.33.26|Deu.33:26]] (גַּאֲוָה) [[2Ma.8.15|2Ma.8:15]] [[2Mac.15.13|2Mac 15:13]], [[3Ma.2.9|3Ma.2:9]] * ;]
**befitting a great man, magnificent, majestic**: [[2Pe.1.17|2Pe.1:17]] (cf. MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3145.def:
**μασάομαι** (Rec. μασσ), -ῶμαι
(Aristoph. and late writers, but not in Trag. or in good Att.. prose), [in LXX: [[Job.30.4|Job.30:4]] (לֶחֶם), [[Sir.19.9|Sir.19:9]] A * ;]
**to bite, chew**: [[Rev.16.10|Rev.16:10]]†
(AS)

G3139.def:
**μάρμαρος**, -ου, ὁ
(μαρμαίρω, to glisten), [in LXX: Ep. [[Jer.7.2|Jer.7:2]] * ;]
1. any crystalline stone (Hom., Eur., al.).
2. **In later writers, marble**: [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]]†
(AS)
